Kapau ʻoku ke loto ki ha fakatātā, tauhi ia kiho fakamatala, pe pulinitī ʻa e tuʻunga pepa: pepa ʻe taha, pene ʻe ua.
howTo: Ko e taha-taha ʻoku fili ʻa hono lanu. Ko e fakaʻilonga ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻoku hā ai ʻa e vuaʻi, mo e lanu ʻo e tangata ko ia ʻi he hingoa.
Tā laina pe sepe ʻe taha ʻaki ʻa e nima, ʻa e mouse pe pene. Pe ʻaki ʻa e kī-ʻeleʻi mo e kī Space ke tā ʻo ʻikai ha pointer.

tips: Nofo ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo e taha ki he taha, pea lea ʻi he taimi ʻoku tā ai: “ʻE u fakahoko ai ʻa e laʻā ʻi he kongakonga.”
Kamata ʻaki ha tuʻutuʻu, ha laina pe ha sepe iiki, pea ʻoange ki he tangata ʻe taha ke ne tali ia.
ʻIkai ha tokotaha ʻoku fiemaʻu ke tā ha fakatātā ʻo ha meʻa. Ko ha tukutuku ʻo e ngaahi laina ʻoku lelei hangē ko ha fakatātā ʻo ha koloa.
Kapau ʻoku ke fie fakaʻosi, tā “Fakaʻosi ʻi he taimi ni”. ʻE ʻikai tauhi ho fakatātā ʻi hono mavahe mei he peesi, kae ʻoua ke ke tauhi ia ʻi ha faile.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha tokotaha ikuna pe sikoa?
faq.a: ʻIkai. ʻOku ʻikai ha tokotaha ikuna, ʻikai ha sikoa, ʻikai ha taimi, pe ʻikai ha lau ʻo e vuaʻi. ʻOku ʻikai ha fakatātā totonu, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻoku fakatuʻutuʻu pe fakatatau ki ha meʻa kehe.

faq.q: ʻOku tauhi pe fekau ʻa e fakatātā?
faq.a: ʻIkai, ʻoku ʻikai fekau ʻa e meʻa ki ha feituʻu. ʻOku tuʻu pē ʻa e fakatātā ʻi he peesi ni ʻo aʻu ki he taimi ʻoku ke tāpuni ai. Kapau ʻoku ke tā “Tauhi ʻa e fakatātā”, ʻe fai ʻiho koloa ha faile ke ke maʻu. ʻOku ʻikai ʻave mai ha meʻa.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke u toe ʻave ha laina?
faq.a: ʻIo. “Toe ʻave ʻa hoku laina fakamuimui” ʻe fakaʻaiʻai ai ʻa e laina fakamuimui ʻo e tangata ʻoku vuaʻi. “Kamata toe” ʻe fakamaʻa ai ʻa e pepa, pea “Toe fakafoki mai” ʻe toe fakafoki mai ai ʻa e ngaahi laina, ʻi he tuʻunga taha pē.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke u ngāue ʻaki ʻa e ʻikai ha mouse pe skrini ʻe ʻiloʻi ʻaki ha nima?
faq.a: ʻIo. Kapau ʻoku tuʻu ʻa e fakatātā, ʻe fakahoko ʻe he kī-ʻeleʻi ʻa e fekau ʻo e tupu-pene, pea ʻe fakalele ʻe he kī Space ʻa e pene ke hiki pe tuku. ʻOku pehē ʻe he skrini ʻa e “Pene ʻi lalo” pe “Pene ʻi runga” taimi taʻe-iku.

faq.q: Ko e ha ʻa e ngaahi lanu, pea ʻe lava ke ʻiloʻi ʻe he kakai ʻoku faingataʻa ʻi he lanu?
faq.a: Melino, moli, lanu ʻakau mo e pioleti, ko e ngaahi lanu fā tatau ʻoku ngāue ʻaki ʻi hotau ngaahi ngaue fakatātā kehe. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e hingoa tohi ʻo e lanu kotoa pē, pea ʻoku hā ʻa e ngaahi hingoa ʻi he vuaʻi. Kuo vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi lanu ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi fakatātā ʻo e ngaahi faingataʻa lahi ʻi he sio ki he lanu, ka ʻoku ʻikai ha taha ʻoku faingataʻa ʻi he sio ki he lanu kuo feinga ʻaki ia.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha founga pepa?
faq.a: ʻIo. “Pulinitī ʻa e tuʻunga pepa” ʻoku pulinitī ai ʻa e pepa ʻe taha ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, mo ha fakatoka lahi ʻoku mahino ke tā ai, maʻa e tangata ʻe ua mo e pene ʻe ua. ʻOku ngāue ia ʻi he uli mo e siʻi.

build-together.name: Langa fakataha
build-together.seoTitle: Langa Fakataha: Tokotaha Ua ‘Oku Langa ha Mahino Taha
build-together.h1: Langa Fakataha: Tokotaha Ua, Kupu Taha
build-together.description: Tokotaha ua ‘oku nau fakatapui ‘a e taimi ke fakahoko ha konga ‘i ha kupu fakataha ‘o a‘u ki he kakato, pea ko e tokotaha taki-taha ‘oku ni‘ihi ha lanu ‘oku ‘i ai hono higoa mo ha fa‘u. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha tokotaha ‘oku ikuna, ‘ikai ha taimi pe sikoa. Ta‘etotongi ke fakahokohoko mo lomi‘i.
build-together.short: Fakatapui ‘a e taimi mo ha tokotaha ‘oku ‘i tafa‘aki ke fakakakato ha kupu fakataha taha.
build-together.intro: Ko ha kupu fakataha ‘oku ‘i ai ‘a e potu 4 ‘i he 4, pe 3 ‘i he 3 kapau ‘oku ke fie ai. ‘E fili ‘e he tokotaha taki-taha ha lanu, pea ‘oku ‘i ai hono higoa tohi mo hono fa‘u ‘a e lanu taki-taha. ‘E fakatapui ‘a e taimi: ‘i ho‘o taimi, tāpuni ha potu wā ke tuku ai ho konga ki ai. Kapau ‘oku ‘i ai ha konga ‘i potu kotoa, ‘oku langa fakataha ‘a e ‘ata. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha tokotaha ‘oku ikuna, koe‘uhi ‘oku mou fakahoko ia ‘o ‘ofa ‘a e ua, pea ‘oku ‘ikai ha me‘a ‘oku tānaki pe fakafe‘iloi. “Lomi‘i ‘a e kupu” ‘oku lomi‘i ai ha kupu wā ‘i ha pepa taha ke mou langa ai mo ‘ai ‘e ua ‘a e peni.
howTo: Ko e tokotaha taki-taha ‘oku fili ha lanu. Ko ha lanu ‘oku ‘i ai ‘a e tokotaha kehe ‘e tohi ai “Ngaue‘aki”.
‘Oku muimui ‘a e tokotaha ‘uluaki. ‘Oku fakahā ‘e he sikelini ko hai ‘a e taimi ‘oku ‘i ai ‘a e taimi mo hono lanu.
Tāpuni ha potu wā ke tuku ai ho konga ki ai. ‘E hoko ‘a e taimi ki he tokotaha kehe.
Kapau ‘oku ‘ikai te ke fie tuku ha konga, tāpuni “Tuku atu”. ‘E lava ke tuku atu ‘e ha tokotaha ‘i ha taimi pe.
Kapau ‘oku ‘i ai ha konga ‘i potu kotoa, kuo mou langa fakataha ‘a e ‘ata. Tāpuni “Kamata foki” ke langa ha me‘a kehe, pe tāpuni Malolo ke tu‘u.
tips: Nofo ‘i he tafa‘aki ‘e taha ke mou sio mo a‘u ki he sikelini. Lea ‘i he ngaahi taimi: “‘E tuku ‘eku konga ofi ki ho‘o konga.”
Feinga ke langa ha ngaahi mahino, ngaahi laine, ha kupu tātā, pe ko e tuku pe ‘i ha potu ‘oku ke fie ai. ‘Oku lelei ‘a e ongo me‘a ‘ni.
Ko e tamasi‘i pe ha tokotaha ‘oku faingofua ke ‘ahi‘ahi‘i ‘e lava ke tuku atu ‘i he taimi ‘oku ne fie ai. ‘E langa pe ‘a e ‘ata fakataha.
‘I he pepa, ko e tokotaha taki-taha ‘oku ne ngaue‘aki ha peni taha mo tā ‘ene fa‘u ‘i he ngaahi kuatea wā.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘i ai nai ha tokotaha ‘oku ikuna, ha taimi pe ha sikoa?
faq.a: ‘Oku ‘ikai. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha tokotaha ‘oku ikuna, koe‘uhi ‘oku mou langa ha ‘ata taha fakataha. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha uata, sikoa, tokanga ki he ngaahi konga pe ‘ikai ke ikuna. ‘E lava ke mou malolo ‘i ha taimi pe, pea ko e malolo ‘i he lotolotonga ko ha founga lelei ‘aupito ke fakaʻosi ai.

faq.q: ‘E tānaki pe fakatonu nai ‘a e me‘a ‘oku mou langa?
faq.a: ‘Oku ‘ikai. ‘Oku nofo pe ‘a e kupu ‘i he peesi ni pe. ‘Oku ‘ikai tānaki, fakatonu pe tokanga ki ai, pea ‘oku mole ia ‘i ho‘o tāpuni ‘a e peesi. Kapau ‘oku ke fie kātaki ia, lomi‘i ‘a e kupu pea langa ‘i he pepa.

faq.q: Kapau ‘oku ou tuku ha konga ‘i ha potu hala?
faq.a: ‘Oku ‘ikai ha potu hala. Tāpuni “Toe ‘ave ‘a e konga fakamuimui” pea ‘e foki ‘a e taimi kiate koe. ‘E lava ke toe ‘ave ‘a e konga ‘e taha ‘i he taimi, pea ‘e lava foki ke toe ‘ave ‘a e tuku atu.

faq.q: ‘E lava nai ke ‘ilo ‘e he kakai ‘oku ‘ikai ‘ilo ‘a e lanu ‘a e lanu ‘e fa?
faq.a: Na‘e fili ia ke ‘e lava. ‘Oku ‘i ai ‘a e hingoa tohi mo ha fa‘u iiki ‘oku ‘i ai ‘a e lanu taki-taha ‘i he konga taki-taha, ko ia ‘oku ‘ikai ko e lanu pe ‘a e founga ke ‘ilo ai. Na‘e vakai‘i ‘a e lanu ‘e fa ‘i he ngaahi fakatātā ‘o e fakaʻilo ‘a e lanu ‘ulu-kulokula mo e lanu ‘ulu-lanu‘uli. Ko e tokotaha ‘oku ‘ikai ‘ilo ‘a e lanu ‘oku ‘ikai te ne ‘osi fakahoko ia ‘i he taimi ni, ko ia ‘oku ou kole ke ke fakahā mai kapau ‘oku tatau ha ‘uhinga ‘e ua.

faq.q: ‘Oku lahi nai ‘a e potu ke ngaue‘aki ‘e he tokotaha ‘oku ‘ai‘ai ‘a e nima pe ha sikelini iiki?
faq.a: ‘Oku ‘ikai ha potu ‘oku si‘isi‘i ange ‘i he pika 56 ‘i he lahi. Kapau ‘oku lahi ange ‘a e kupu ki he sikelini, ‘e fakatu‘u ia ‘i loto ‘i hono kato pe, ‘ikai ke si‘isi‘i ‘a e ngaahi potu.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘i ai nai ha fakatonu ‘i he pepa?
faq.a: ‘Io. Ko e “Lomi‘i ‘a e kupu” ‘oku lomi‘i ai ha kupu wā ‘i ha pepa taha, mo e lanu ‘e ua mo honau higoa, ke langa ai mo ‘ai ‘e ua ‘a e peni. ‘E ngaue ‘i he ‘uli mo e siasi, koe‘uhi ‘oku ‘i ai ‘a e fa‘u ‘o e lanu taki-taha.

faq.q: ‘Oku ta‘etotongi nai, pea ‘oku fiema‘u nai ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: Ee, ko e me‘a ta‘etotongi, pea ‘oku ‘ikai ha kaunga, ‘ikai ha fakahingoa pe download. ‘Oku ngaue ‘i he web browser ‘i he telefoni, tablet pe kompiuta.

seated-toss.name: Tu‘u ‘a e tohi‘i ‘o e tatau nofo
seated-toss.seoTitle: Tohi‘i ‘o e Tatau Nofo: Me‘a Tatau Pōpō ki he Tokotaha Ua
seated-toss.h1: Tohi‘i ‘o e Tatau Nofo: Tatau Fakataha ‘i he Tēpile
seated-toss.description: Tokotaha ua ‘oku nofo ‘i he tēpile ‘oku nau fakatapui ‘a e taimi ke tatau ha pōpō malu ki ha potu lahi, pea tohi‘i ‘a e ‘ikai ‘i he pepa. ‘Oku ‘ikai fakatatau ha taimi pe ‘ikai ha sikoa. Ta‘etotongi ke lomi‘i.
seated-toss.short: Fakatapui ‘a e taimi ke tatau ha pōpō ki ha potu lahi, mo e tohi‘i ‘i he pepa.
seated-toss.intro: Ko ha me‘a fakafiefia malū ‘i he tatau ki he tokotaha ua ‘oku nofo ‘i he tēpile. ‘Oku mou tu‘u ‘a e potu ‘oku lomi‘i ‘i he tēpile, pea fakatapui ‘a e taimi ke tatau ha pōpō malu, pe ha sokisi ‘oku fakapulu, ke tō ‘i he ngaahi mama. ‘E tohi‘i ‘e he tokotaha taki-taha ‘a e ‘ikai ‘i ha ngaahi kuposi ‘i he pepa, pea ‘e vakai fakataha ki he tohi‘i ‘i he taimi ‘oku mou tu‘u ai. ‘Oku ‘ikai fakatatau ha taimi, ‘ikai tānaki ‘i he sikelini, pea ‘oku ‘ikai tānaki pe fakatonu ‘a e me‘a ni. Fakalele ‘a e ngaahi fakamatala malu ‘i he kamata: ko e ngaahi me‘a iiki ‘i loto ‘oku ‘i ai ha talanoa ki he ngoue.
howTo: Lau ‘a e ngaahi fakamatala malu. Fili ha puke ‘oku tāpuni ‘a e tukui, pe fakapulu ha sokisi ma‘a.
Tāpuni “Lomi‘i ‘a e potu mo e pepa tohi‘i” pea tuku ia ‘i he tēpile ‘i he lotolotonga ‘o kimautolu.
Nofo ‘i he ‘ofa, ‘e taha ‘i kotoa ‘a e tafa‘aki, pea fakatapui ‘a e taimi ‘e taha ‘ene tatau malū. ‘E lava ke tuku atu ‘e ha tokotaha.
Kapau ‘oku tō ha tatau ‘i ha mama, tohi‘i ha kuposi ‘i he kolomu ‘oʻoku, ‘i he laine ‘o e mama ko iá.
Vakai fakataha ki he ngaahi tohi‘i ‘i he taimi ‘oku mou malolo ai, pe tāpuni Malolo ke fakanofo.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Ko e tō malū ia." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Ko ha taimi pe ko ha sikoa?
faq.a: Ikai. Ko ha uati, sikoa, tokoni ngaue pe ha ngaue ke hē. Ko e lava ke ke fakamavahe ʻi ha taimi ʻoku ke loto ai, pea ko e fakamavahe ʻi ha vaʻa ko ha founga lelei ʻaupito ke fakaʻosi ai.

faq.q: Ko e haʻu ʻoku malu ke tō ha ʻeke fa'ahinga kiʻi pi 'ako?
faq.a: Ko e malu ia, ka ʻoku fie mahino ke ke fai ʻaki e tokanga. Ke ngaohi ʻaki ha ʻeke ʻoku kuo tuʻutuʻu ʻa hono kofu pe ha sokisi ʻoku kuo tōtō, ʻo ʻikai ko e fakaʻaiʻai ʻaki ha kiʻi pi 'ako, laisi, pe ha me'a iiki, ʻoku lahi ʻaupito ʻa e hako ʻaki ia ʻe he kau tamaiki iiki mo ia kuo fakaʻuli ʻa e me'a ki hono ngutu. Nofo ʻi he nofoʻanga, tō malū ki he laopapa, pea ʻoua naʻa tō ki ha mata, pea tuku ha tokotaha lahi ke ofi.

faq.q: Ko ha me'a ʻoku ʻai ke lau pe fakamanatu ʻi he sikirini?
faq.a: Ikai. Ko e fakalau ʻoku ʻi he pepa pe, ʻi he ngaahi kahha ʻoku mou tā ʻaki hangatonu. Ko e pēisi ʻoku ʻikai ke fakamanatu ʻa e lau pe taimi, pea ʻoku ʻikai ke tēpile pe fakaʻuhinga ʻa e me'a.

faq.q: Ka ko e hā ʻoku ʻikai malu ke tō ʻe ha tokotaha pe ʻe hinga ʻa e ʻeke ʻi tu'a he laopapa?
faq.a: ʻE lava ke ʻalu ha tokotaha, pea ko e ʻeke ʻoku hinga ʻi tuʻa he laopapa ʻe toki hiki ia ke tō ʻi he vaʻa hoko. ʻOku ʻikai lau ia.

faq.q: Ko e hā ʻoku ʻi he pepa ʻoku paʻi?
faq.a: Ko e pepa ʻe taha: ko ha laopapa lahi ʻoku ʻi ai hono ngaahi kiʻi kelekele ʻe tolu ko e Ofi, Lotoloto mo e Mama'o, ko ha tēpile ʻoku ʻi ai ha kolomu ki ha tokotaha kotoa, mo ha laini ʻo e ngaahi kahha iiki ke tā ki he kiʻi kelekele kotoa, mo ha laini ʻo e fakatotolo malu. Ko e ngaahi hingoa ʻoku tohi ʻi he ngaahi kelekele, ko ia ʻe lava ai ke ngāue ʻi he uʻuli mo e Pēlesi.

faq.q: Ko e koloa ia, pea ʻoku fie ngaue ke tohi hingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ko e koloa ia, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha akauni, tohi hingoa pe fakaʻiloa. ʻE lava ke ngāue ʻi he vēpesaiti ʻi he telefoni, tapolo pe kompiuta.

faq.q: Ko e pēisi ʻoku ʻiloa ʻe ia ʻa e vaʻa ʻo e taʻu?

faq.q: Ka ko e hā ʻoku ʻikai ha taha ʻoku loto ki he ngaahi puzzle ʻi he ʻaho ni?
faq.a: Fili ʻa e "ʻOku ʻaho malōlō ʻi he ʻaho ni". Ko e pēisi ʻe fakaʻikai ai ha laini malu pe, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha me'a ke paʻi pe ngaue.

faq.q: Ko e hā ʻoku ʻi he pepa ʻoku paʻi?
faq.a: Ko e pepa ʻe taha ki he vaʻa kuo mou filí: ko e ngaahi puzzle ʻe tolu, ʻo ʻeku ai ha laini nounou ki he founga ke fai ai, mo ha laini ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e fakalea ʻe lava ke fai ʻa e ʻe taha, ua pe tolu.

faq.q: Ko e koloa ia, pea ʻoku fie ngaue ke tohi hingoa?

decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. howTo: Filifili ha ʻaho fakamanatu, pea toki ʻaki ʻa "Paʻi ʻa e kāti".

finish-the-saying.intro: ʻOku faʻa ʻiloa ʻa e ngaahi lea ko ia ʻi he moʻui kotoa. ʻOku ʻi he kāte kotoa ha lea ʻoku ʻiloa, ʻo ʻikai ha lea ʻi he fakaʻosinga, ngaahi tali ʻe tolu, mo e patani “Fakahā ʻa e fakaʻosinga”. howTo: Lau ʻa e lea leva ʻo fakataha.

Tā ʻa e tohi ʻuluaki ʻo e kupu, pea tā ʻa e tohi hope.

coloring.description: Ngaahi peesi lanu faingofua ki he kakai motua ʻoku ʻi ai ha potu lahi: tā ʻa e lanu, pea tā ʻa e konga ʻo e tāʻā. ʻOku ʻikai ha lanu hala, pea ʻe lava ke lolomi ʻa e peesi kotoa ʻoku ʻikai totongi.
coloring.short: Tā ʻa e lanu, pea tā ʻa e konga ʻo e tāʻā. ʻE lava foki ke lolomi ʻa e peesi.
coloring.intro: Peesi ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi tāʻā lahi mo faingofua: ko e fuá ʻi he ipu, ko e fale, ko e tī ʻoku ʻi ha ipu, ko e pepe, mo e vaka lauʻi. Tā ʻa e lanu, pea tā ha konga ʻo e tāʻā ke fakakīʻi ia. ʻOku ʻikai ha lanu hala.

Tā ha konga ʻo e tāʻā ke fakakīʻi ia ʻaki e lanu ko iá.

conversation-cards.description: Ngaahi kāati fakatātā mo e ngaahi lea fakalongolongo ki he fāmili, kaume'a mo e kakai motua, ʻo kau ai e kakai ʻoku nofo mo e mahaki fakaʻatamai (dementia). ʻOku ʻikai ha fehuʻi fakasiviʻi, pe ko e tali totonu.
conversation-cards.short: Kāati tāʻā mo e ngaahi fehuʻi mā‘oluolu. ʻIkai ha fehuʻi ki he fakamanatu.
conversation-cards.intro: Ko e kāati kotoa ʻoku ʻi ai ha tāʻā ʻoku ʻilo, mo ha fakaafe ke talanoa, hangē ko “Ko e hā ʻa e ʻea ʻoku ke ʻofa ʻaupito ki ai?” ʻOku ʻikai ha tali totonu pe ko e maʻu ke manatu. Fili ha kaveinga pe fakatafeholo ʻa e kāati kotoa.
howTo: Fili ha kaveinga, pe tuʻu ki he “Kāati kotoa”.
Lau ʻa e fehuʻi ʻi he leo lahi, pea vakai ki he tāʻā fakataha.
Fanongo, fakahā hoʻo tali ʻoku, pea tuku ke ʻalu ʻa e talanoa.

Kapau ʻoku ʻai ʻe ha kāati ha ongo mamahi, ʻoku ʻai ke talia ʻa e ongo ko iá mo e liliu mā‘oluolu ki ha kāati kehe.

faq.q: Ko e hā ʻoku ʻikai ai ha fehuʻi “ʻOku ke manatu…?”
faq.a: Ko e ngaahi fehuʻi ʻoku fakatotolo ki he fakamanatu ʻoku lava ke hangē ko ha ʻekisāmi, ʻo ʻai ai ha maʻuʻā. Ko e ngaahi fakaafe mā‘oluolu hangē ko “Talanoa mai ki he…” ʻoku lava ke kau ai ha taha, ʻi he me‘a ʻoku ne manatu ai.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke u lolomi ʻa e ngaahi kāati?
faq.a: ʻIo. “Lolomi ʻa e kāati kotoa” ʻoku lolomi ai ʻa e seti kotoa ʻi he tohi lahi, ʻe lahi ʻa e kāati ʻi he peesi kotoa, ʻoku lelei ke tipuʻi.

coloring-wall.name: Group coloring wall
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Group Coloring Wall: One Picture for Many Hands
coloring-wall.h1: Group Coloring Wall: One Big Picture, Colored Together
coloring-wall.description: Print one large picture across several pages, so a family, a class or a care home can color one wall together. Free to print. No timer or score.
coloring-wall.short: Print one big picture across pages for many people to color.
coloring-wall.players: A group, at a table or on a wall
coloring-wall.intro: Choose a picture from the coloring pages and a wall of 4, 6 or 9 pages. Print the wall: the first page shows how to put it together, and each of the other pages is one part of the same big picture, with a label such as A1 in its corner. Each person colors one or more pages, in any colors and any style. The pages are then laid out by their labels and joined with tape on the back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
howTo: Choose a picture, then choose how many pages the wall has.
Read the map on the screen, which shows where each label goes.
Tap "Print the wall" and print all the pages.
Give each person one or more pages to color. Colors and styles do not need to match.
Lay the pages out by their labels, and join them with tape on the back.
tips: Give the pages with the simplest outlines to the people who want a quieter task, and the busier ones to anyone who enjoys them.
Hang the wall where everyone can see it, and talk about the parts together.
Choose a smaller wall for a small table, and a bigger one for a room.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: Kāsi. ʻOku ʻikai fakataimi, fakamaau pe lau ha me'a, pea ʻikai ha tokotaha ikuna. Ko e kupu ko ia ko ha ngaahi fakatata kuo kulokula ʻe ha tokolahi.

faq.q: ʻE tānaki pe fekau ʻa e ngaahi peesi ki ha feituʻu?
faq.a: Kāsi. ʻOku fakatupu ʻa e kupu ʻi he peesi ni pe. ʻOku ʻikai tānaki, fekau pe lau, pea ʻe ʻalu ia ʻi he taimi ʻe tāpuni ai ʻa e peesi.

faq.q: ʻOku fiema'u ke fe'unga ʻa e kala?
faq.a: Kāsi. ʻE lava ke ʻi ai ʻa e kala mo e founga ʻe taha-taha ʻe he tokotaha kotoa. ʻE hoko pe ʻa e ngaahi peesi ko e fakatata ʻe taha.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha founga pepa?
faq.a: ʻIo. Ko e kupu kuo pālisi ko e kemi kotoa ia: ko e peesi ʻuluaki ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi sitepu mo e mape, pea ko e peesi ʻe taha ki he konga kotoa ʻo e fakatata.

faq.q: Ko e koloa ia, pea ʻoku fiema'u ke ke tohi hingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ko e koloa ia, pea ʻikai fiema'u ha akaʻunti, tohi hingoa pe download. ʻE ngāue ia ʻi he web browser ʻi he telefoni, tablet pe kompiuta.

quiet-shapes.name: Quiet shapes puzzle
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit Shapes Into a Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit the Pieces into the Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Fit simple shapes into the outline of a house, a boat, a fish and more. Tap a piece, then a space of the same shape. There is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
quiet-shapes.short: Fit simple shapes into a picture, at your own pace.
quiet-shapes.intro: A picture outline, such as a house, a boat or a rocket, is divided into spaces. Each space has a piece of the same shape, a large or small triangle, a square, a parallelogram or a rectangle. Tap a piece, then tap a space of the same shape, and it fits. The space turns the piece for you, so there is nothing to drag or rotate. If a piece is a different shape from a space, it stays in the tray with a short note. Nothing is timed or scored, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print this shape" prints the outline and its pieces on one page to color or cut out.
howTo: Tap a piece in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a space in the picture. If the shape matches, the piece fits there.
If it does not match, try another space. Nothing is lost by trying.
Tap a piece in the picture to take it back to the tray, or use "Start again" to take all of them back.
When every space has its piece, the picture is complete. Tap "Another shape" for a new one, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Kamata e ngaahi lea ko e ngaahi kongokonga ke ke sio ki ha ngaahi potu. Fakatafe ia kapau ko e fie ngāue ke hangē ko ha puzzle, ko e ngaahi tafa pe ke ke tataki ai.
Kamata mo e ngaahi shapes lalahi, hangē ko e ngaahi triangles lalahi mo e ngaahi rectangles. Ko e ngaahi konga iiki ko e taimi lahi ia ke hoko mamaki.
Ke lea ki he ngaahi shapes ke ke fai ia: "ko e triangle, ko e square, ko e rectangle lōloa". Ko e lea 'a e taha ki he taha ke fai ai ha ngāue fakataha.
Ke ngāue ki he pepa, tā ki he ngaahi konga ia 'aki ha ngaahi langa ʻe ua pe tolu, pe tā ia ke ke tā ʻaki ha tokoua lahi ʻi he taimi ko iá.

faq.q: Ko e 'ē, ‘oku ‘i ai ha taimi, ha sikoa pe ha lahi ‘o e ngaahi ngaue?
faq.a: ‘Ikai. ‘Oku ‘ikai fakataimi, fakalahi pe fakamaau ha me‘a. Ko e konga ‘oku ‘ikai fe‘unga ‘oku ‘ikai fakatuʻu pe, pea te ke tuʻu ‘i ha taimi ‘oku ke fie ai.

faq.q: Ko e me‘a ‘oku tau fai ‘oku teuteu‘i pe fekau‘aki?
faq.a: ‘Ikai. ‘Oku nofo pe ‘a e ta‘u ‘oku ‘i he peesi ni pe. ‘Oku ‘ikai teuteu‘i, fakaʻuhinga pe fakalahi, pea ‘oku ‘alu ia ‘i he taimi ‘oku ke tāpuni ai e peesi.

faq.q: ‘Oku lahi ‘a e potu ‘oku ‘i ai ha tōtō pe ha sikilini iiki?
faq.a: ‘Oku tātā ‘a e kongokonga ‘i he lahi taha ‘e malava ‘e he sikilini, pea ko e potu kotoa ko ha pātani ‘e malava ke ke ‘aki ‘aki ha vai pe ko e kī Tab. Ko e ngaahi konga ‘i he tray ko e ngaahi pātani lalahi ‘o e peesi.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘i ai ha fakatotolo ‘i he pepa?
faq.a: ‘Io. Ko e "Print this shape" ‘oku ne pulusi ha ta‘u ‘e taha ‘i ha peesi ‘e taha: ko e kongokonga mo e ngaahi tafa ‘o ia, pea mo e ngaahi konga ‘oku tā ‘i he lahi tatau ‘i he ‘ahi‘ahi‘i. Tā ‘a e ngaahi konga, pe tāpuni ke ‘i loto ‘i ia. Ko e tokotaha lalahi te ne malava ke tāpuni.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘ikai ha totongi, pea ‘oku fie ngaue ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: ‘Io, ‘oku ‘ikai ha totongi, pea ‘oku ‘ikai fie ngaue ke fakahingoa, pe download. ‘Oku ngāue ‘i he browser ‘i he telefoni, tablet pe kakai ‘i he kompiuta.

calm-breathing.name: Mānava Filemu
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Ko e Kuonga Fakamālohia ‘o e Mānava Fakafiemālie ke Fakataha
calm-breathing.h1: Ha Taimi Filemu ʻo e Mānava
calm-breathing.description: Ha taimi mānava fiemālie mo filemu ke fakatahaʻi: ha kāutaha ʻoku tupu mo mamaʻa ʻi he ongo mānava ʻe ono. Ko koe ʻoku kamata, pea ʻe lava ke ke tuku ʻi ha taimi.
calm-breathing.short: Ha kāutaha ʻoku mānava ai. Kamata pe tuku ʻi ha taimi ʻoku ke loto ki ai.
calm-breathing.intro: ʻI he taimi lahi, ko e ngāue lelei taha ko ha taimi filemu. Tuʻu ʻo “Kamata”, pea mānava ʻi he taimi ʻoku tupu ai ʻa e kāutaha, mo ʻaʻaku ʻi he taimi ʻoku mamaʻa ai. Filifili ha vave pe ngingila ʻo e founga. ʻOku ʻikai ko ha faitoʻo, ka ko ha taimi fiemālie ke fakatahaʻi.
howTo: Nofo fiemālie ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻe taha.
Filifili ʻa e vave: ngingila pe fiemālie.
Tuʻu ʻo “Kamata”. Mānava ʻi he taimi ʻoku tupu ai ʻa e kāutaha, pea ʻaʻaku ʻi he taimi ʻoku mamaʻa ai.
ʻE tuku ia ʻi he taimi ʻe ono ʻo e mānava, pe tuʻu ʻo “Tuku” ʻi he taimi ʻoku loto ki ai.
tips: Fekumi ʻa e nima pe tuku ha nima ki he nima ʻo e tokotaha kapau ʻoku talitali lelei ia.
ʻOua ʻe fakamālohi. Kapau ʻe loto ia ke vakai pē, ko ia ʻoku lelei.
Kapau ʻoku ʻi ai ha faingataʻa ʻi he mānava, mānava ʻo hangē ko e founga ʻi he ʻaho pea vakai pē ki he kāutaha. Fehuʻi ki ha foungamotuʻa ki ha ngaahi tokanga ʻo e mānava.

faq.q: Ko ha ngāue mānava faitoʻo ni?
faq.a: ʻIkai. Ko ha taimi filemu, faingofua, ʻoku ʻikai fiemaʻu, mo e kau fakataha. ʻOku ʻikai ko ha faitoʻo ki he manavahē pe ha mahaki ʻe taha. Talanoa mo ha foungamotuʻa ʻi he ngaahi tokanga ʻo e moʻui.

faq.q: ʻOku fetuʻutaki ʻa e kāutaha ʻo ʻikai ke u kamata ia?
faq.a: ʻIkai. ʻOku ʻikai ke fakanekeneka ha me'a ʻoua ke ke tōmui ʻi he Kamata, pea ʻe ngata ia hili ʻa e mānava ʻe ono pe ʻi ho tōmui ʻi he Taʻofi. Kapau kuo fakatonutonu ho fakamatala ke siʻisiʻi ʻa e nekeneka, ʻe liliu pē ʻa e ngaahi lea ka ʻe ʻikai ke tupu ʻa e tōʻā.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻikai ha totongi ia, pea ʻe fiemaʻu ke ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ʻoku ʻikai ha totongi, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha kaunga, fakahingoa pe download. ʻE ngāue ia ʻi he laka ʻi he initaneti ʻi he telefoni, tapaleti pe komipiuta.

story-chain.name: Ko e kakano ‘o e talanoa
story-chain.seoTitle: Story Chain: ko ha ngāue talanoa fakataha ‘aki ha ngaahi ta‘u
story-chain.h1: Story Chain: Ko e talanoa ‘i he ta‘u ‘e taha ‘i he taimi
story-chain.description: Ko e laini ‘o e ngaahi ta‘u ‘oku tupu ‘i he taimi ‘e taha, pea ‘oku lea ‘a e tokotaha kotoa ‘i ha fuofua lea ki ai ‘i he leo. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha me‘a ke tā, ‘oku ‘ikai ha tali totonu. Ko e ngāue ‘oku ‘ikai ha totongi, fakafiemālie, ‘oku ‘ikai ha taimi pe sikoa.
story-chain.short: Fakahoko ha ta‘u, pea ke lea ‘a e tokotaha kotoa ‘ha fuofua lea, ‘i he ki‘i tu‘unga-fai.
story-chain.intro: ‘Oku kamata ‘a e ngāue ‘i ha ta‘u ‘e taha, pea ‘oku tupu ‘a e laini ‘i he ta‘u ‘e taha ‘i he taimi. ‘Oku lea ‘a e tokotaha kotoa ‘i ha fuofua lea ‘o fekau‘aki mo e laini ‘oku ‘i ai he taimi ni, ‘i he leo, ‘i he taimi ‘o ‘ene vilo. Ko e fuofua lea ‘e lava ke fekau‘aki mo e me‘a ‘oku mou sio ki ai, ha potu ‘oku ‘omi ‘e ia ki he loto, pe ha me‘a fakafiefia. ‘Oku ‘ikai tā, ‘oku ‘ikai teuteu‘i pe tauhi, ‘oku ‘ikai ha tali totonu, pea ‘e lava ke tu‘u ha tokotaha ‘o ‘ikai lea. Ko e laini ‘oku ‘ikai ke ‘i ai ‘a e ta‘u ‘e valu, pea ‘i he taimi ko iá te mou lava ai ‘o kamata ha laini fo‘ou.
howTo: Sio fakataha ki he ta‘u ‘uluaki.
Vilo ‘a e tokotaha kotoa: ‘e lea ‘a e tokotaha kotoa ‘i ha fuofua lea ki he laini ‘oku ‘i ai he taimi ni. ‘E lava ke tu‘u ha tokotaha ‘o ‘ikai lea.
Tōtō ‘a e "Add a picture" ke fakahoko ‘a e ta‘u hoko ‘i he tu‘a ‘o e laini.
Tōtō ‘a e "Take the last one off" kapau ‘oku ke fie foki ki he ta‘u ki mui.
Kapau ‘oku ‘i ai ‘a e ta‘u ‘e valu ‘i he laini, tōtō ‘a e "Start a new chain" ke kamata ha laini fo‘ou, pe tuku pe ke tu‘u.
tips: ‘Oku lelei ‘a e fuofua lea pe‘i: "Na‘e tō ‘e ha tokotaha ‘a e tapuaki ki he vai." Ko e tokotaha hoko ‘e kumi ki mu‘a, pe ‘e tu‘u.
Tuku ke tataki ‘e he ngaahi ta‘u ‘a e talanoa. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha talanoa ‘oku totonu ke ke ō ki ai.
Tu‘u ‘i ha taimi ‘oku ke fie ai. Ko e tu‘u ‘i he vahe‘ ‘oku lelei pe ko ha founga ke fakaʻosi ai.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘i ai ha taimi pe ha sikoa?
faq.a: ‘Ikai. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha uási, sikoa, lahi ‘o e ngaahi tafa pe ha faingata‘a. ‘E lava ke ke tu‘u ‘i ha taimi pe ‘oku ke fie ai, pea ko e tu‘u ‘i he vahe‘ ‘oku lelei pe ko ha founga ke fakaʻosi ai.

faq.q: ‘Oku tā pe tohi ‘a e lea?
faq.a: ‘Ikai. ‘Oku lea ‘a e ngaahi fuofua lea ‘i he leo, pea ‘oku ‘ikai tā, tohi, teuteu‘i pe fekau‘aki ki ha feitu‘u. ‘Oku fakahā pe ‘e he ngāue ‘a e ngaahi ta‘u.

faq.q: Ko e hā ‘oku ‘ikai loto ha tokotaha ke lea?
faq.a: ‘E lava ke tu‘u ha tokotaha ‘o ‘ikai lea, pea ‘e kōlanga ‘e he tokotaha hoko. ‘Oku ‘ikai fie ngaue ha tokotaha ke hingoa pe manatu ki ha ta‘u.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘ikai ha totongi, pea ‘oku fie ngaue ke fakahingoa?
faq.a: ‘Io, ‘oku ‘ikai ha totongi, pea ‘oku ‘ikai fie ngaue ke fakahingoa, pe download. ‘Oku ngāue ‘i he browser ‘i he telefoni, tablet pe kakai ‘i he kompiuta.

quiet-scene.name: Ko e sīnō fakamālohia
quiet-scene.seoTitle: Quiet Scene: ko e ta‘u ‘e taha ‘i he taimi
quiet-scene.h1: Quiet Scene: ko e ta‘u mālohi ‘e taha ‘i he taimi
quiet-scene.description: Ko e ta‘u lalahi mo mālohi ‘e taha ‘i he taimi, pea ko e lea fakamālohia ‘e taha ‘i lalo ‘o e ta‘u kotoa. Tōtō ‘a e Next pe Previous ‘i ha taimi ‘oku ke teuteu ai. ‘Oku ‘ikai ngaue pe ‘alu ‘a e ta‘u ‘i he‘ene ‘ā, pea ‘oku ‘ikai ha taimi pe sikoa. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha totongi, pea ‘oku ‘ikai fie ngaue ke fakahingoa.
quiet-scene.short: Sio ki ha ta‘u mālohi ‘e taha ‘i he taimi, ‘i ho‘o tu‘unga-fai.
quiet-scene.players: Ko koe pe, pe ko ha kulupu ‘i he potu tatau
quiet-scene.intro: Ko ha ta‘u lalahi ‘e taha ‘oku ‘i ai ‘a e sikilini kotoa, pea ‘oku ‘i lalo ai ha lea nounou ‘e taha. Tōtō ‘a e "Next picture" pe "Previous picture" ‘i ha taimi ‘oku ke fie ai ha ta‘u kehe. ‘Oku ‘ikai ngaue, ‘alu pe liliu ‘a e ta‘u ‘i he‘ene ‘ā, pea ‘oku ‘ikai fakataimi ha me‘a. Tōtō ‘a e "Bigger picture" ke fakahā pe ‘a e ta‘u, koe‘uhi ke lava ‘o sio ai ‘a e kakai kotoa ‘i he televisone.
howTo: Sio fakataha ki he ta‘u.
Lau ‘a e lea ‘i lalo ‘o ia ‘i he leo, kapau ‘oku ke fie.
Tōtō ‘a e "Next picture" pe "Previous picture" ‘i ha taimi ‘oku ke teuteu ai.
Tōtō ‘a e "Bigger picture" ke fakahā pe ‘a e ta‘u, pea ‘a e "Show everything" ke toe fakahā ‘a e me‘a kotoa.
Tu‘u ‘i ha taimi ‘oku ke fie ai ‘aki ‘a e "Done for now".
tips: Tuku ke filifili ‘e he tokotaha ‘i he taimi ke ‘alu ai: vahe‘i ke sio ‘a ia, pea tōtō ‘a e Next.
Ki ha kulupu, ‘aki ‘a e "Bigger picture" ‘i he televisone pe ki ha sikilini lalahi, pea nofo ‘i ha potu ‘oku lava ke sio ai ‘a e kakai kotoa.
‘Oku ‘ikai ha founga totonu ke sio ai ki ha ta‘u. Ko e lea fekau‘aki pe ki ai ko ha ngāue katoa.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘i ai ha taimi pe ha sikoa?
faq.a: ‘Ikai. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha uási, sikoa, lahi ‘o e ngaahi tafa pe ha faingata‘a. ‘E lava ke ke tu‘u ‘i ha taimi pe ‘oku ke fie ai, pea ko e tu‘u ‘i he vahe‘ ‘oku lelei pe ko ha founga ke fakaʻosi ai.

faq.q: ‘Oku ‘ikai ngaue ‘a e me‘a leo pe ‘alu?
faq.a: ‘Ikai. ‘Oku ‘ikai ha leo, pea ‘oku ‘ikai ngaue, ‘alu pe liliu ‘a e me‘a ‘i he‘ene ‘ā. ‘Oku liliu pe ‘a e ta‘u ‘i he taimi ‘oku ke tōtō ai ha pātani.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha founga pepa?
faq.a: ʻIkai. Ko e fakatātā eni ke sio ai fakataha ʻi ha sikalīni. Ko ha ta'a ʻoku ʻofa ʻaupito pe ko ha kāati fakatātā ʻi he laulau ʻe fai ʻe ia ʻa e meʻa tatau.

faq.q: Ko e ta'etotongi ia, pea ʻoku fiema'u ke tohi hingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ko e ta'etotongi ia, pea ʻikai ha akaunti, tohi hingoa pe ma'u mai. ʻOku ngāue ia ʻi he browser ʻi ha telefoni, tablet pe kompiuta.

color-wash.name: Lanu vai
color-wash.seoTitle: Lanu Vai: Lanu Malu ʻi he Peesi Kātoa
color-wash.h1: Lanu Vai: Tā ʻa e Lanu Malu ʻi he Peesi
color-wash.description: Ko e palasi malu ʻoku tā ai ʻa e ngaahi lanu vai lahi mo malu ʻi he peesi ʻe taha, ʻi he lanu ʻe fā mo e ngaahi lahi ʻe ua ʻo e palasi. ʻOku ʻikai ha ngata, ʻikai ha sikoa mo ha taimi. Ta'etotongi ke fakahoko, ʻikai ha akaunti.
color-wash.short: Tā ʻa e ngaahi lanu vai malu ʻi he peesi, ʻi hoʻo tuʻunga taimi ʻa koe.
color-wash.players: Taha, pe ʻe 2 ʻoku tuʻu ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻe taha
color-wash.intro: Peesi ʻe taha mo e palasi malu ʻe taha. Fili ha lanu mo ha lahi ʻo e palasi, pea heka ʻi he peesi ke tā ai ha lanu vai. ʻOku ʻikai ha ngata ʻi he peesi: ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ke fakaʻosi, ʻikai ha fakatātā ke tonu ai, pe ha sikoa. Tā ʻa e ngaahi lanu vai ʻe lahi ʻo hangē ko ia ʻoku ke fiemaʻu, pe tuku hifo ʻa e palasi pea sio pe. Ko e “Peesi foʻou” ʻe fakamaʻa ai ʻa e meʻa kotoa, pea ko e “Fakafoki mai” ʻe toe ʻomi ai ʻa e lanu vai.
howTo: Fili ha lanu. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e hingoa tohi ʻo e lanu ʻi ai.
Fili ʻa e “Lahi” pe “Lahi ʻaupito”. Ko e “Lahi ʻaupito” ʻe kāpui ai ʻa e peesi lahi ange ʻi he heka kotoa pē.
Heka ʻi he peesi ʻaki ha nima, ha mausi pe ha peni ke tā ai ha lanu vai.
Pe ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi kī fakahaʻi ke fakahoko ʻa e mohu palasi, pea ʻaki ʻa e kī vahe ke tuku hifo pe hake ʻa e palasi.
Tāʻi ʻa e “Peesi foʻou” ke fakamaʻa ʻa e peesi, pea “Fakafoki mai” kapau ʻoku ke fiemaʻu ke toe maʻu ʻa e lanu vai.
tips: Tuku ke fili ʻe he taha kehe ʻa e lanu ʻo e lanu vai hoko, pea talanoa ʻi he ngaahi lanu ʻi he taimi ʻoku tā ai.
Ko e “Lahi ʻaupito” ʻoku faingofua ange ke tataki ʻaki ha nima ʻoku mahanga, koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻikai ke fiemaʻu ke tonu ʻaupito ʻa e palasi.
ʻOku ʻikai ha founga totonu ke tā ai. Tuku ke ke fakangata ʻi ha taimi ʻoku ke fie ai, pe tāʻi ʻa e “Kuo fakaʻosi ʻi he taimi ni”.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha ngata, ha sikoa pe ha taimi?
faq.a: ʻIkai. ʻOku ʻikai ha ngata ʻi he peesi. ʻOku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻoku fakaʻosi, fakalau, fakataimi pe fakasikoa, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha fekau ʻoku kole ke ke fai ha meʻa lahi ange.

faq.q: ʻOku tauhi pe fekau ʻa e peesi?
faq.a: ʻIkai. ʻOku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻoku tauhi, paʻi pe fekau ki ha feituʻu. ʻOku nofo ʻa e lanu vai ʻi he peesi ni ʻo aʻu ki he taimi ke ke mavahe ai.

faq.q: ʻE lava ke u ʻai ʻaki ʻo ʻikai ha mausi pe sikalīni ʻoku tāʻi?
faq.a: ʻIo. Kapau ʻoku tuʻu ʻa e peesi, ʻe tataki ʻe he ngaahi kī fakahaʻi ha mohu palasi, pea ʻe fakahoko ʻe he kī vahe ʻa e tuku hifo pe hake ʻo e palasi. ʻOku pehē ʻe he sikalīni ʻa e “Palasi hifo” pe “Palasi hake” ʻi he taimi kotoa.

faq.q: ʻOku ʻi ai ha founga pepa?
faq.a: ʻIkai. Ko e tā lanu vai ʻi he pepa ʻoku tatau ʻa e fakakaukau, ko e palasi ʻoku vai pea lanu ʻe taha ʻi he taimi. Ko ia ko ha ngāue kehe ke feinga ai ʻi he laulau.

faq.q: Ko e hā ʻa e ngaahi lanu?
faq.a: Melino, ʻolenisi, uliuli mo e vaioleti, ko e ngaahi lanu tatau ʻe fā ʻoku ngāue ʻaki ʻi he ngaahi ngāue fakatātā kehe ʻa Creative Activities. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e hingoa tohi ʻo e lanu kotoa, pea ʻoku hā ʻa e hingoa ʻi tafaʻaki ʻo e fili.

faq.q: Ko e ta'etotongi ia, pea ʻoku fiema'u ke tohi hingoa?
faq.a: ʻIo, ko e ta'etotongi ia, pea ʻikai ha akaunti, tohi hingoa pe ma'u mai. ʻOku ngāue ia ʻi he browser ʻi ha telefoni, tablet pe kompiuta.
